interactive.welcome: Daily Agent · Local Qwen decides whether plain input should be stored; x reverses the last decision; short prefixes work (/d = /delete); /recent to view logs; /connections to analyze links; /exit to quit
override.hint: Enter x within 10 minutes to reverse this decision.
override.unavailable: There is no recent decision to reverse.
terminal.link:
Send /link {code} in Telegram.
The pairing code expires in 10 minutes and can only be used once.
telegram.start: Welcome to Daily Agent. Local Ollama only decides whether plain text should be stored; it is not sent to GLM. Only explicit advanced features call GLM. First run `daily-agent link-telegram` in Terminal, then send `/link CODE` here.
telegram.linked: Pairing successful. You can now send logs directly.
telegram.invalid_pairing: The pairing code is invalid, expired, or already used. Generate a new one in Terminal.
telegram.not_linked: Not paired yet. Generate a pairing code in Terminal, then send `/link CODE`.
telegram.help:
Plain text: local Qwen only decides whether to store it
x or /x: reverse the latest plain-input decision within 10 minutes
/log TEXT: force save without a model decision
/private TEXT: force save and prohibit GLM upload
/recent: recent logs
/connections: call GLM for advanced connection analysis
/delete ID: delete by ID
/delete -N: delete the Nth newest log, N from 1 to 10
/export: export JSON
/privacy: privacy information
Commands accept the shortest unique prefix (e.g. /d = /delete); /link and /log require the full word
telegram.privacy: Original text is stored in plaintext SQLite. Ordinary input is sent only to local Ollama. GLM is called only by explicit advanced features such as /connections, after local redaction. Telegram messages still pass through Telegram servers. Do not send passwords or other highly sensitive information.
telegram.storage_ignored: This input was not stored. Enter x within 10 minutes to save it.
telegram.storage_ask: I could not determine whether to store this input. Enter x within 10 minutes to save it.
telegram.saved: Saved [{id}]. Enter x within 10 minutes to undo.
telegram.truncated: …Output was too long and has been truncated
analysis.need_two_logs: At least two logs are required to analyze connections.
error.invalid_delete_position: Delete position must be from -1 to -10; for example, /delete -1 deletes the newest log
